context: Tests resource counting, loading the detailed workflow reference, resilient parsing and per-resource tracking.

checklist.name: Counts resources
checklist.description: Counts the resources (three) before running the tools and records the count in the report

checklist.name: Loads the workflow reference
checklist.description: Reads references/validation_workflow.md because the file has three or more resources

checklist.name: Continues past the error
checklist.description: Continues validating the Service (document 1) and the Certificate (document 3) after the Deployment (document 2) fails to parse

checklist.name: File-absolute line numbers
checklist.description: Reports the syntax error at line 13 of the file (the `kind Deployment` line) and not the document-relative line 2

checklist.name: Per-resource table
checklist.description: Shows the status of each resource (parsed, skipped, valid) in a table

checklist.name: Validates as a unit
checklist.description: Runs the dry-run on the whole file and not resource by resource

checklist.name: Order matters
checklist.description: Notes that resource order matters, or tests the file as a unit for that reason

checklist.name: Detects the CRD
checklist.description: Detects the Certificate as a CRD

checklist.name: Does not abort
checklist.description: Does not stop the workflow at the first failing document

checklist.name: Report only
checklist.description: Does not edit the file or apply fixes

checklist.name: Summary and next steps
checklist.description: Ends with a summary of stages and next steps
